purpose: Freeze meaning AND structure criteria before candidate generation; do not accept meaning preservation alone.
status: development criteria for six known public sources; not a blind holdout
meaning_gate: Compare every source assertion to output and every output assertion to source. Preserve objects, actors/roles, condition/exception scope, time trigger and boundary, counts and units, automatic versus manual action, modality, negation, and uncertainty. Any changed or uncertain meaning blocks acceptance.
structure_gate: A case passes only if meaning is preserved and all case-specific structural criteria pass. Different wording, honorifics, or valid heading/bullet choices are not independent failures. Raw outputs are never repaired.

required_structure: Return objects appear in the first substantive block as separate list items
Responsible team remains identifiable without repeating the list in prose
Portal and department collection are separate groups
Within each group eligibility, actor/action, and deadline are separate visible items or lines
Automatic mandatory-training omission check is visibly common to both methods, outside the last method's scope
nonblocking_observations: Record repeated introductory statements without inventing an automatic failure threshold

required_structure: The triggering cancellation condition is visible before its automatic notification result
Notification, response obligation, and nonresponse follow-up are numbered stages in their real sequence
Receipt-based response deadline remains attached to its response stage
Each local condition/actor is explicit and no new common condition scope is invented
Default and outside-working-hours exception are separate visible branches
Each branch has its deadline on an independently identifiable line/item
The exception explicitly replaces rather than adds to the default deadline
The acknowledgment action and responsible actor remain connected to both deadlines
The first substantive statement identifies the deployment restriction or semantic omission that limits final use
Normal execution of all twelve transformations remains separately visible as execution-layer evidence
Repair duty and prohibition before re-review remain directly identifiable
prohibited_inferences: Do not invent an unconditional failure of all transformations
Do not infer automatic permission after re-review

required_structure: Absent notation in the material and unconfirmed designation remain distinct
Do not invent a procedure, numbered workflow, extra action or explanatory paragraph for these two short status facts
allowed: Use two compact status lines if both scopes remain clear

rule_boundary_review: Grammar/spelling-only requests retain the user's structure
One short condition with one action can remain one sentence
Independent alternatives/attributes use bullets rather than implied sequence
Simultaneous obligations must not become sequential steps
Unknown condition scope must not be resolved by inventing a heading
A negative fact is not automatically the most important result; the source must establish the limiting relationship
Missing notation and unknown designation do not establish nonexistence
comparison_limits: Old full-dictionary outputs are historical references only. New baseline-profile and candidate-profile arms each use one unchanged source and one profile per request; compare these two matched arms for this trial.
Profile-only baseline and candidate form a separate matched pair; do not attribute differences across input scopes solely to rule changes
Provider default instructions, routing internals and actual host loading are outside the text-input experiment
No human reading-time or rereading measurement is performed
token_gate: Always-loaded candidate profile must fit6000 tokens in recorded counters. All six complete candidate requests must also report usage.input_tokens <=6000; preserve output even if this gate fails.
